summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repository without running tests or committing. Changes: (1) rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union. (2) rich/control.py: added the OSC 0 formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. (3) rich/console.py: added set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring warnings. (4) rich/_windows_renderer.py: added an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. (5) CHANGELOG.md: added an Added heading under Unreleased with one bullet linking pull request 2200. (6) Tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on legacy consoles), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Verification was by reading only; no tests were run, as instructed. Choices: CHANGELOG bullet wording was my own, and the union is written one shape per line.
